description: Element complementation takes Boolean filters to ideals and ideals to filters; the operations are inverse and preserve properness.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.complement_duality.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (F : Order.PFilter B)
  (I : Order.Ideal B) :
  Order.IsIdeal (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualIdeal F) ∧
    Order.IsPFilter (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualFilter I) ∧
      (∀ (a : B), aᶜ ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualIdeal F ↔ a ∈ F) ∧
        (∀ (a : B), aᶜ ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualFilter I ↔ a ∈ I) ∧
          (⊤ ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualIdeal F ↔
              Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsProperFilter F) ∧
            (⊥ ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualFilter I ↔ I.IsProper)
